blocks.text: When two functional groups are available to form a linkage, condensation polymerisation takes place, usually with a small molecule removed. The two groups may be in one molecule (e.g. lactic acid) or in two different molecules (as in nylon-6,6). The common pairs are:

items: amino group (-NH2) and carboxylic acid group (-COOH): a polyamide and water
amino group and acyl chloride (-COCl): a polyamide and HCl
carboxylic acid group and alcohol (-OH): a polyester and water
acyl chloride and alcohol: a polyester and HCl
Give the polymer formed from 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, HO-C6H4-COOH: its repeat unit, linkage and the attraction between chains.
Give the polymer formed from benzene-1,4-diamine and a cyclopentanedicarboxylic acid: its repeat unit, linkage and the attraction between chains.
